about.title: About Bloomshire Tool
about.subtitle: A free tool made by the community, for the community.
about.notOfficial: This is an unofficial community tool. It is not made, endorsed or supported by the Bloomshire team.
about.mayErr: Data comes from the game and is updated often, but it may contain mistakes or fall behind after a game update. Double-check anything important in the game.
about.noSecrets: The tool never asks for your seed phrase or private key, and signing in never moves funds.
about.contactTitle: Found a bug or have an idea?
about.contactBody: Mistakes, suggestions and improvements are all welcome. Write to me on Discord:
about.coffeeBody: If the tool helps you, you can buy me a coffee by sending whatever you like to this wallet. It keeps the tool online and growing. Totally optional!
about.walletNote: EVM address. Always check it ends in …{{end}}. I will never ask you to sign anything to donate.
about.footer: Unofficial community tool, not affiliated with Bloomshire. It may contain errors.
